feedback_interpretation: Recent measured outcomes confirmed that aromatic-basic and amino-nitrile rows remain the highest-impact failure region, with large late V1 and V2 errors for m141, m146, m66, m216, and amino-nitrile positional cases. Oxygenated and carbonyl-rich outcomes remained heterogeneous, with both severe V2 underprediction and V2 overprediction, weakening any universal tail correction. Donor-free anchors were generally more stable but still showed topology-dependent residuals. The corrected batch therefore combines local condition and loading contrasts with broad graph coverage and controls.
batch_rationale: The batch includes repeated molecules and related graph families for interpretable PE/EA and loading response learning, while retaining donor-free, sulfur, halogen, ester, alcohol, nitro, and carbonyl anchors across the catalog. These labels can repair interaction terms in the severe nitrogen region, calibrate structure-specific V2 tails, and preserve generalization across common lower-complexity rows. All 32 choices are distinct candidate-table IDs.
